summary: Reuse the newest pnpm store cache for the same operating system and Node/pnpm versions when the lockfile changes in Workspace CI and main cache upkeep, and allow three minutes for web detection and gate jobs including runner teardown.

replay.detail: CI cache reuse only; no runtime state replay.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or authority rule change.

compatibility.detail: Exact lockfile cache keys and frozen workspace installs remain unchanged; fallback stores only supply reusable packages.

recovery.detail: Cache entries expire normally; no persisted runtime state change.
